title: BOJ’s Deputy Chief Flags AI’s Possible Impact on Neutral Rate
key_facts: He said AI has been a large positive demand shock, lifting prices and easing financial conditions on balance.
He warned of a correction if profits do not follow the investment boom.
AI has lifted stock prices (looser conditions) while heavy AI-related bond issuance has pushed up long-term rates.
AI could affect the output gap, financial conditions and 'star variables' such as the neutral rate.
AI could raise productivity and capital stock over time, with positive and negative effects on labour markets.
He did not comment directly on the near-term rate path.
quote_evidence: AI has been a big positive demand shock lifting prices and easing financial conditions on balance (investingLive's summary of Uchida).
why_it_matters_hint: A central bank is treating AI as a force on inflation and interest rates.
notes: Only a secondhand summary was readable.
